title: Saying 'you too' when the waiter says enjoy your meal

narrator.style: clear, clean, crisp studio voice with precise articulation, smooth, not breathy, not raspy; dry deadpan narrator, slightly unimpressed, natural pace

theo.style: clear, clean voice, not breathy, not raspy; cheeky young guy roasting his friend, trying not to laugh

lines.say: The waiter puts down your food and says: enjoy your meal.
Easy. One job. Say thank you.
He's not eating. He's working. He has no meal.
You just wished a grown man a nice lunch at his own job.
You stare at your pasta like it knows some shit.
Your brain replays it in slow motion. With commentary.
Across the table, Theo is dying.
You too? You too, bro? He's holding a fucking tray!
Then the waiter comes back. Is everything okay?
You panic. You say: yes. Love you.
You leave a fifty percent tip. Out of pure shame.
That's not a tip. That's hush money, you dumbass.
At the door, the waiter says: have a nice evening.
You've learned. You've grown. You've healed.
You hold the door for him and say: enjoy your meal.
